title: Steering in Long-Context Settings: Does Vector Influence Persist Over Context Length

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: if steering decays over generation length, long-context deployments are unsafe despite steering. Primarily a characterization result but directly deployment-relevant.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires generating long sequences (4K tokens) with steering applied and measuring toxicity at intervals. Medium compute can handle this for a single model. Requires some care with memory management for long generations but is manageable.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused: apply steering, generate long sequences, measure probe scores at 100-token intervals, plot decay curve. Single experiment with clear output. Completable in 30 hours.
